title: Seeds and transplants
competency: Compare planting from seeds and from transplants.

keywords.def: The small, hard part of a plant from which a new plant grows.
Moving seedlings from containers into the garden or field.
Slowly giving transplants more sun each day over a week.

en.text: A seed is the small hard part of a plant from which a new plant grows. Seeds are cheaper and come in more kinds. Transplanting moves seedlings from containers into the garden; it gives a harvest sooner. Harden transplants off slowly and plant them at the same depth. Root crops do not transplant well.

screens.title: Faster harvest
screens.after: Transplants are already growing, so the harvest comes sooner.

screens.title: Seeds
paras: A seed is the small, hard part of a plant from which a new plant grows.
It is sown in a field or garden and germinates after some time.
There are more kinds of seeds than transplants, and seeds cost less.

screens.title: Transplanting
paras: Transplanting is moving seedlings from containers into the garden or field.
Gardens with transplants harvest sooner than with seeds.
Harden seedlings off: give them full sun a bit longer each day for a week.
Plant them at the same depth as in the container. Tomatoes can go slightly deeper.
screens.note: Root crops like carrots, radishes and beets do not transplant well.

screens.title: Key words
defs: The small, hard part of a plant from which a new plant grows.

screens.text: What is one advantage of seeds over transplants?
opts: Seeds are cheaper and come in more kinds
screens.ans: Seeds are cheaper and come in more kinds
screens.why: The book: more variety of seeds, and they are less expensive.
Root crops do not transplant well. Sow them as seeds.

screens.title: Put the transplanting steps in order
items: Harden them off over a week
Plant at the same depth in the garden
screens.clue: What must happen before they go into full sun?

screens.text: Selam has one short rainy season and wants tomatoes and carrots. What is the best plan?
opts: Transplant tomatoes; sow carrot seeds directly
screens.ans: Transplant tomatoes; sow carrot seeds directly
screens.why: Transplants harvest sooner, which helps in a short season. Carrots are root crops, which do not transplant well, so sow them as seeds.
screens.clue: Which crop does not transplant well?
